gmail_authorize_help: Google asks you to allow Luma to read and send email in this mailbox. Luma reads only messages that match your inbox rules and sends only replies your workspace allows. You can cancel before approving.
gmail_authorize_mailbox_help: Google preselects this account. Connect a shared team mailbox, such as orders@, rather than a personal one.
gmail_authorize_invalid: Enter a connection name and, if you add a mailbox address, a valid one.
gmail_access_check_failed: Luma couldn’t check this mailbox’s Gmail access. {error}
gmail_access_unknown: Luma has no recorded Google access for this mailbox. Reconnect it to authorize access.
gmail_access_read_granted: Luma can read messages that match your inbox rules.
gmail_access_read_missing: Google hasn’t granted access to read email, so Luma can’t read this mailbox. Reconnect it and allow reading email.
gmail_access_send_granted: Luma can send approved replies from this mailbox.
gmail_access_send_missing: Google hasn’t granted access to send email, so replies can’t be sent from Luma. Reconnect the mailbox and allow sending to turn it on.
gmail_rules_help: Luma never reads the whole mailbox. It asks Gmail only for messages from the senders, to the addresses, or with the labels in your inbox rules.
gmail_token_help: Enter a new access token for {address}. Then validate access so Luma can read the mailbox again.
